about_the_game:
Elemental Fusion

In the demo version, you can experience six basic elements in the game (Light, Dark, Fire, Thunder, Ice, and Wind). Players can freely mix and match elements, and defense towers will gain different abilities based on the elements they combine. By strategically combining elements and utilizing unique elemental synergy effects, you can build an increasingly solid and impenetrable defense system.

Team Cooperation

The demo version supports online multiplayer for up to 4 players. You can work together with your teammates to devise defensive strategies and fend off wave after wave of enemy attacks.Please note that the trial version cannot be connected to the official version.

Campaign Mode

In the demo version’s single-player mode, only a limited number of campaign missions are available. Each unique campaign features different types of enemies and introduces new defense towers. Successfully completing a mission will unlock new defense towers. As you progress through the campaigns, you will become more familiar with the game's core mechanics and gameplay.

More Content

The demo version offers only a limited selection of defense towers and levels. The full version will provide a richer experience with more defense towers, levels, synergies, enemies, and an entirely new upgrade system, bringing you a deeper and more engaging gameplay experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 processor or later that's SSE2 capable
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 processor or later that's SSE2 capable

short_description: This is a minimalist-style tower defense game that is easy-going and relaxing, with a moderate level of difficulty. Build your tower formations to fend off enemies. It also supports online multiplayer, allowing you to team up and experience an unprecedented level of tower defense fun!
supported_languages: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Spanish - Spain
